protocol_ref: PREREGISTRATION.md section 7 (quant crossover pilot, bounded Tower2 window) + section 2 arm table
_sampler_provenance: official-nothink sampler, value-identical to configs/official-nothink.json: Qwen3.6-27B README @6a9e13bd L635-637; Qwen3.8-27B README @1d4bf0f2 L252-253. Thinking off for every cell.
_design: Both models x {UD-Q4_K_XL, Q8_0}, seeds 101/211, 12 families = 96 cells on Tower2's two RTX PRO 6000s. GPU<->model assignment is CROSSED between the two seeds (host_plan: seed101 puts Qwen3.8 on GPU0 + Qwen3.6 on GPU1; seed211 swaps them). Within a seed the window runs two co-residency waves (serving.waves): wave 0 = both models at UD-Q4_K_XL, wave 1 = both models at Q8_0; one container per GPU per wave, containers torn down between waves. Family-major interleave with alternating model start, same parity rule as run_crossover.sh: first model = the q38-side container iff (seed_index + family_index) is even.
_decision_rule: Preregistered (section 7): if Q4-vs-Q8 paired delivery difference within either model has |delta| >= 15 pp with McNemar p < 0.05, quantization is implicated and a BF16 arm is added for that model in a new bounded window; otherwise the quant-causal question is reported from this pilot alone. No quant claim of any kind from single-model evidence.

serving._docker_deltas_vs_historical_lanes: llama-server argv is byte-identical to ensure-q38-tower1-only.sh / ensure-q36-tower3-only.sh except --model/--alias (values: --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --n-gpu-layers 999 --ctx-size 262144 --batch-size 2048 --threads 4 --parallel 1 --flash-attn on --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 --jinja --reasoning-format none --no-context-shift --metrics). Docker-level deltas, forced by the two-GPU Tower2 topology: --gpus device=<uuid> instead of --gpus all; -v /mnt/bulk/models:/models:ro instead of the tower-local ~/ods/data/models store; -p 127.0.0.1:<1820x>:8080 instead of :11434; per-cell container names + quant-pilot labels.

drain._restore: DSV4 drain at window open and restore + baseline verification at window close are ORCHESTRATOR-OWNED (PREREGISTRATION.md section 7). run_quant_pilot.sh only (a) refuses to open the window while any forbidden container is running and (b) prints the restore reminder at close. It never stops or starts DSV4 itself.
